dedupe_keys.name: epa e manifest data schema and interface documentation

description: The US Environmental Protection Agency publishes e-Manifest's machine-readable schema, examples and service documentation for hazardous-waste shipment records. The resource defines the structure used to exchange information about generators, transporters, receiving facilities, waste quantities and manifest processing. It includes JSON schemas and valid and invalid message examples, with Python, Java and TypeScript client references. Coverage is the United States hazardous-waste manifest system, with record-level structure and versioned service updates, not an observation time series. Public repository material is free under CC0-1.0. A limitation is that the schema contains no complete waste-flow dataset, and protected API or test-system operations require registration and appropriate site roles. The public definitions can help harmonise hazardous-waste inputs for transport and treatment-capacity simulations, complementing EPA RCRAInfo biennial statistics (data-epa-rcrainfo-biennial-report-hazardous-waste). The official documentation explains the manifest lifecycle and public-data timing. No account, shipment record or protected endpoint was accessed. This record concerns the reusable data specification.
